a.lede: The theft of agents' personal information could present a major counterintelligence threat, where agents and their families are extorted into cooperating with a foreign government.
a.title: Hacking group ShinyHunters claims it breached the FBI, stole agents’ and applicants’ data

b.lede: Experts say the hack could leave agents vulnerable to scams, blackmail and targeted attacks.
b.title: Special agents' blood and urine test results stolen in FBI hack
